items.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Expands Partnerships For Enterprise AI Workflows
items.summary: ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is expanding partnerships to roll out agentic AI and large-scale AI workflows across enterprise customers. Partner LTM is deploying ServiceNow AI Agents and the Super Intelligence Control Tower internally as a model for wider adoption. Companies such as KORE and Keysight are choosing the ServiceNow platform to support next-generation customer experience and efficiency solutions. items.title: Datadog Just Dropped 34% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 34% in a week, first in a software selloff that also hit ServiceNow and Cloudflare, then on a flat fourth-quarter outlook. That outlook assumes Datadog’s largest customer, an AI company, pays only its minimum; growth from everyone else is guided to the low to mid-30s.

items.summary: Palantir just posted the fastest revenue growth in its public company history, yet investors are selling the stock. Understanding what spooked the market reveals a tension between two very different stories buried inside the same earnings report.
